name: Dance of the Wanderers
text:
Requirements You're in Stellar Dance Stance, and your dance isn't at its zenith.

---
Like those celestial wanderers who defiantly cross the sky in the opposite direction of the rest of the stars, you move gracefully across the battlefield. You leap twice; neither action triggers reactions. At the end of this movement, your dance reaches its zenith, and you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speeds while your dance is at its zenith.
